description: Map the PSMD2/Rpn1 BAG1-binding residues onto C. elegans RPN-1 by local alignment
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"})
def fa(a):
    r=S.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60); r.raise_for_status()
    return "".join(r.text.split("\n")[1:]).strip()
HUM=fa("Q13200"); WRM=fa("Q9GZH5")
B62t="""   A  R  N  D  C  Q  E  G  H  I  L  K  M  F  P  S  T  W  Y  V
A  4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0
R -1  5  0 -2 -3  1  0 -2  0 -3 -2  2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2  0  6  1 -3  0  0  0  1 -3 -3  0 -2 -3 -2  1  0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2  1  6 -3  0  2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1  0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C  0 -3 -3 -3  9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1  1  0  0 -3  5  2 -2  0 -3 -2  1  0 -3 -1  0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1  0  0  2 -4  2  5 -2  0 -3 -3  1 -2 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G  0 -2  0 -1 -3 -2 -2  6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2  0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2  0  1 -1 -3  0  0 -2  8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2  2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3  4  2 -3  1  0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1  3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3  2  4 -2  2  0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1  1
K -1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S  1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2
T  0 -1  0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  5 -2 -2  0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1  1 -4 -3 -2 11  2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3  2 -1 -1 -2 -1  3 -3 -2 -2  2  7 -1
V  0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
Ls=B62t.strip().split("\n"); cols=Ls[0].split(); Bm={}
for l in Ls[1:]:
    p=l.split()
    for c,v in zip(cols,p[1:]): Bm[(p[0],c)]=int(v)
def sc(a,b): return Bm.get((a,b),Bm.get((b,a),-4))
def sw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2)
    SM=np.array([[sc(a,b) for b in s2] for a in s1],float)
    H=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); E=np.full((n+1,m+1),-1e9); F=np.full((n+1,m+1),-1e9); ptr=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    best=(0,0,0)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        Hi=H[i]; Hp=H[i-1]; Ei=E[i]; Fi=F[i]; Fp=F[i-1]; pi=ptr[i]; si=SM[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            e=max(Ei[j-1]+ge, Hi[j-1]+go); Ei[j]=e
            f=max(Fp[j]+ge, Hp[j]+go); Fi[j]=f
            d=Hp[j-1]+si[j-1]
            v=d
            if 0>v: v=0
            if e>v: v=e
            if f>v: v=f
            Hi[j]=v
            pi[j]= 0 if v==0 else (1 if v==d else (2 if v==e else 3))
            if v>best[0]: best=(v,i,j)
    v,i,j=best; mp={}
    while i>0 and j>0 and H[i,j]>0:
        k=ptr[i,j]
        if k==1: mp[i]=j; i-=1; j-=1
        elif k==2: j-=1
        elif k==3: i-=1
        else: break
    return mp,v
LO,HI=390,500
mp,score=sw(HUM[LO-1:HI],WRM)
print(f"SW local alignment human PSMD2 {LO}-{HI} vs worm RPN-1 (full): score={score:.0f}, aligned pairs={len(mp)}")
CONT=[422,423,424,426,427,430,433,434,457,458,459,460,461,463,464,465,467]
rows=[]
for p in CONT:
    j=mp.get(p-LO+1)
    w=f"{WRM[j-1]}{j}" if j else "gap"
    st="identical" if (j and WRM[j-1]==HUM[p-1]) else ("similar" if (j and sc(HUM[p-1],WRM[j-1])>0) else "divergent")
    rows.append(dict(human_PSMD2=f"{HUM[p-1]}{p}", worm_RPN1=w, status=st,
                     contacts_BAG1_residue="yes"))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("\n=== PSMD2/Rpn1 residues that contact the BAG1 ULD in 9HEU, mapped to C. elegans RPN-1 ===")
print(df.to_string(index=False))
ni=sum(r["status"]=="identical" for r in rows); ns=sum(r["status"]=="similar" for r in rows)
print(f"\nidentical {ni}/{len(CONT)} ({100*ni/len(CONT):.0f}%), similar {ns}, divergent {len(CONT)-ni-ns}")
ks=sorted(mp); a1="".join(HUM[k+LO-2] for k in ks); a2="".join(WRM[mp[k]-1] for k in ks)
ov=100*sum(1 for x,y in zip(a1,a2) if x==y)/len(a1)
print(f"overall identity across the aligned window: {ov:.1f}% over {len(a1)} residues "
      f"(human {ks[0]+LO-1}-{ks[-1]+LO-1} vs worm {mp[ks[0]]}-{mp[ks[-1]]})")
for s in range(0,len(a1),70):
    print("  H:",a1[s:s+70]); print("    ","".join("|" if x==y else (":" if sc(x,y)>0 else " ") for x,y in zip(a1[s:s+70],a2[s:s+70]))); print("  W:",a2[s:s+70])

# ---- figure ----
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,3.6))
x=np.arange(len(CONT))
colmap={"identical":"#54A24B","similar":"#F2CF5B","divergent":"#E45756"}
ax.bar(x,[1]*len(CONT),color=[colmap[r["status"]] for r in rows])
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels([f"{r['human_PSMD2']}\n{r['worm_RPN1']}" for r in rows],fontsize=7)
ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xlabel("human PSMD2 (top) / C. elegans RPN-1 (bottom)")
ax.set_title(f"The BAG1-binding surface of PSMD2/Rpn1 is conserved in C. elegans RPN-1\n"
             f"{ni}/{len(CONT)} contact positions identical, {ns} chemically similar "
             f"(window identity {ov:.0f}%)")
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
ax.legend(handles=[Patch(color=colmap[k],label=k) for k in colmap],fontsize=8,ncol=3,loc="lower center")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
df.to_csv("/tmp/psmd2_worm.csv",index=False)
